text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Arab Emirates accuses Iran of threatening fishing boats in the Gulf.
- The UAE is ready to transport food and medicine to Iraq under the oil-for-food deal signed with the United Nations.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)

- A U.N. team to visit Iraq to assess Saddam River chosen by the U.N. Development Project as the best project in the world to fight desertification. The artificial river stretches from Baghdad to the Gulf.
- Iraqi customs authorities in 1996 seized 600 artifacts before they were smuggled out.
- Editorial criticising Turkey's incursions in northern Iraq and blaming and condemning Iran for recent explosions in Baghdad.
